lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਭੁ ਧੂਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam bihoone naanakaa hot jaat sabh dhoor ||1||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, all are reduced to dust. ||1||
Pauree:
DHADHA: The dust of the feet of the Saints is sacred.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਤੇਊ ਜਿਹ ਰੁਚ ਇਆ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan teoo jih ruch iaa manooaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed are those whose minds are filled with this longing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਨ ਆਛਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan nahee baachhahi surag na aachhahi ||
lines.translation: They do not seek wealth, and they do not desire paradise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਰਜ ਰਾਚਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: at pri preet saadh raj raachahi ||
lines.translation: They are immersed in the deep love of their Beloved, and the dust of the feet of the Holy.
How can worldly affairs affect those,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਏਕ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo ek chhaad an katahi na jaahoo ||
lines.translation: Who do not abandon the One Lord, and who go nowhere else?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ ਦੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai heeai deeo prabh naam ||
lines.translation: One whose heart is filled with God's Name,
O Nanak, is a perfect spiritual being of God. ||4||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਅਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik bhekh ar ngiaan dhiaan manahath miliau na koi ||
lines.translation: By all sorts of religious robes, knowledge, meditation and stubborn-mindedness, no one has ever met God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa bhaee bhagat ngiaanee soi ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, those upon whom God showers His Mercy, are devotees of spiritual wisdom. ||1||
Pauree:
NGANGA: Spiritual wisdom is not obtained by mere words of mouth.
It is not obtained through the various debates of the Shaastras and scriptures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: ngiaanee soi jaa kai driR sooo ||
lines.translation: They alone are spiritually wise, whose minds are firmly fixed on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat sunat kachh jog na hooo ||
lines.translation: Hearing and telling stories, no one attains Yoga.

lines.gurmukhi: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਰਹਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ngiaanee rahat aagiaa driR jaa kai ||
lines.translation: They alone are spiritually wise, who remain firmly committed to the Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: usan seet samasar sabh taa kai ||
lines.translation: Heat and cold are all the same to them.
The true people of spiritual wisdom are the Gurmukhs, who contemplate the essence of reality;
O Nanak, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||5||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਨ ਆਏ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan aae srisat mahi bin boojhe pas dhor ||
lines.translation: Those who have come into the world without understanding are like animals and beasts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh so bujhai jaa kai bhaag mathor ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who become Gurmukh understand; upon their foreheads is such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਯਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਹਿ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: yaa jug mahi ekahi kau aaiaa ||
lines.translation: They have come into this world to meditate on the One Lord.
But ever since their birth, they have been enticed by the fascination of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: garabh ku(n)t mahi uradh tap karate ||
lines.translation: Upside-down in the chamber of the womb, they performed intense meditation.
They remembered God in meditation with each and every breath.
But now, they are entangled in things which they must leave behind.
They forget the Great Giver from their minds.
O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy,

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: it ut naanak tis bisarahu naahee ||6||
lines.translation: do not forget Him, here or hereafter. ||6||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavat hukam binaas hukam aagiaa bhi(n)n na koi ||
lines.translation: By His Command, we come, and by His Command, we go; no one is beyond His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa tih mitai naanak jih man soi ||1||
lines.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended, O Nanak, for those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ||1||
Pauree:
This soul has lived in many wombs.
Enticed by sweet attachment, it has been trapped in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: in maaiaa trai gun bas keene ||
lines.translation: This Maya has subjugated beings through the three qualities.
Maya has infused attachment to itself in each and every heart.
O friend, tell me some way,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤਰਉ ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa te tarau bikham ih maaiaa ||
lines.translation: by which I may swim across this treacherous ocean of Maya.
The Lord showers His Mercy, and leads us to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kai nikat na maae ||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, Maya does not even come near. ||7||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸੁਭ ਅਸੁਭ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirat kamaavan subh asubh keene tin prabh aap ||
lines.translation: God Himself causes one to perform good and bad actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pas aapan hau hau karai naanak bin har kahaa kamaat ||1||
lines.translation: The beast indulges in egotism, selfishness and conceit; O Nanak, without the Lord, what can anyone do? ||1||
Pauree:
The One Lord Himself is the Cause of all actions.
He Himself distributes sins and noble acts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਜੁਗ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: iaa jug jit jit aapahi laaio ||
lines.translation: In this age, people are attached as the Lord attaches them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: so so paaio j aap divaaio ||
lines.translation: They receive that which the Lord Himself gives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: uaa kaa a(n)t na jaanai kooo ||
lines.translation: No one knows His limits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਊ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo karai sooo phun hooo ||
lines.translation: Whatever He does, comes to pass.
From the One, the entire expanse of the Universe emanated.
O Nanak, He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||8||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੁਸਮ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਖ ਸੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: raach rahe banitaa binod kusam ra(n)g bikh sor ||
lines.translation: Man remains engrossed in women and playful pleasures; the tumult of his passion is like the dye of the safflower, which fades away all too soon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰਉ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tih saranee parau binas jaai mai mor ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, seek God's Sanctuary, and your selfishness and conceit shall be taken away. ||1||
